title: Maintainer overview
description: Develop and release tempjs CLI and website templates from the monorepo.

blocks.title: Monorepo layout
blocks.text: packages/core (shared) + templates/overlays/* (per template) → pnpm sync-templates → templates/*-website-template (what tempjs copies).

blocks.code:
edit packages/core OR templates/overlays/hotel/
pnpm sync-templates
pnpm dev:hotel
tempjs version check
tempjs version inc patch hotel
git commit

blocks.text: Bump them independently. See the Versioning page for tempjs version check / inc.
